Bug_Details: The type of the array parameter of Collection.toArray needs to be compatible with the array type
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs because the type of the array parameter provided to Collection.toArray is not compatible with the elements of the collection. In this case, a List<String> is trying to be converted to an Integer[] array. This will compile but cause a runtime ArrayStoreException.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method from the CollectionToArrayExample class. This method contains a bug at line 13, where a List<String> is attempted to be converted into an Integer[] using the toArray method. This causes an ArrayStoreException at runtime, triggering the bug.
